_readme: Fleet events: the orchestrated shows (docs/characters/FLEET-EVENTS.md). Each is a conductor scene hosted on
this node's selected character (Orlok). run-next.mjs rotates through `events` in order, one per invocation,
and is fired by the managed crontab every half hour in show hours (see README.md).
quietHours: the runner refuses to start a show between start and end (local time, America/Chicago on every Pi).
busyRetry: when any node reports a live guest conversation, wait delayMs and look again, up to attempts times.
playTimeoutMs: how long one conductor may run before the runner gives up on it and releases every node.

`scheduled`: events with their own cron line, outside the rotation (`run-next.mjs --event <id>`). An entry with "node" is that node's scene, played through that node's scene API: the Nosferatu (hourly) and Slipknot (disabled) conductors are Groundbreaker's.

`interrupt`: (operator 2026-10-23) every event this runner plays, moments included (--moment), ends any guest conversation, stops scene queues and holds every animatronic's lurk first, plays in full, then releases and puts every animatronic back in lurk mode, armed. One lock for all of them, so two scheduled events can never overlap.

`syncGoblinReels`: after every show the runner restarts the Goblins' coordinated set reels together (scripts/goblins/sync-reels.mjs, plan scripts/goblins/set-plan.json), so the windows show one subject at a time again.
